entry.title: 🇦🇹 SAP CodeJam ABAP Cloud (Vienna, Austria)
entry.content:
THIS EVENT IS NOW AT CAPACITY AND REGISTRATION IS NOW CLOSED!!!!

This SAP CodeJam event is on the topic of the ABAP Cloud, and specifically introduces attendees to ABAP Cloud and the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model. ABAP Cloud is the ABAP based development model for S/4HANA Cloud, S/4HANA on premise, and SAP BTP, ABAP environment. Learn how to use proven and new technologies, such as Core Data Services (CDS) and behavior definition and implementation languages, to build SAP Fiori apps and OData services on any of the ABAP Cloud options. In this hands-on experience, developers will create their first ABAP applications using ABAP Cloud, expose and consume services via HTTP, and explore the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model.

This is an in-person event only (not virtual) and is planned for Friday 08 November 2024 in Vienna, Austria  from 09:00 - 16:00 GMT+1. The language of the event and the content will be English. 

Location: SCC EDV-Beratung AG, Mantlergasse 30-32, 1130 Vienna, Austria
The instructor is Lukas Bretschneider

Here are essential prerequisites that must be completed by every attendee, before arriving at the event location. They are documented here: abap-exercises-codejam/prerequisites.md at main · SAP-samples/abap-exercises-codejam (github.com).

The event is kindly being hosted by SCC EDV-Beratung AG, thank you! Please note that spaces are limited - we can only accommodate 30 attendees. Register here in the Community Event using the RSVP functionality.

For more information on SAP CodeJam events, to ask questions, and to chat with your fellow attendees, head over to the SAP CodeJam group.

entry.title: 🇵🇱 SAP CodeJam ABAP Cloud (Warsaw, Poland)
entry.content:
his SAP CodeJam event is on the topic of the ABAP Cloud Development Model in SAP S/4HANA.  

We will give you an introduction about the ABAP Cloud Development in an SAP S/4HANA on-premise environment which is available in SAP S/4HANA as of release 2022. The fundamental principle is that ABAP cloud-ready and ABAP classic code can coexist in the same system since the ABAP language version is defined on ABAP object level. This offers a gradual transition from the classic to the cloud extensibility model.

For this workshop we will provide you with access to system running on release SAP S/4HANA 2023 FSP01.

To understand the basic idea of ABAP Cloud Development you will learn how to:

- Use the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP) to develop transactional Fiori applications

- Use public SAP APIs released by SAP to access SAP functionality and SAP data

- Use public SAP extension points released by SAP to extend SAP objects

- Use ADT (ABAP Development Tools) as your ABAP IDE

With the SAP S/4HANA 2022 release the same extensibility model can now be used in SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition, and SAP S/4HANA.

This is an in-person event only (not virtual) and is planned for Friday 19  September 2025 in Warsaw Poland  from 02:00pm - 8:00pm local time. The language of the event and the content will be English. 

Location:  KMD Offices,  Inflancka 4A, Warsaw, Poland

The instructor is Ingo Braeuninger from SAP.

Please note that spaces are limited - we can only accommodate 30 attendees. Register here in the Community Event using the RSVP functionality.

entry.title: 🇩🇪 SAP CodeJam ABAP Cloud & ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model – SPECIAL EDITION
entry.content:
REGISTRATION IS NOW CLOSED FOR THIS EVENT - We will send confirmation emails to first 35 registered participants.  Please comment below in case you want to be considered in the waitlist. If there are any dropouts, we can consider including those in the waitlist(subject to host approval).

 

In this SPECIAL EDITION of the ABAP Cloud & RAP CodeJam,  we want to address the experienced RAP developer that wants to learn first hand from our experts about the newest features that have been added to the RAP framework with the 2511 and the upcoming 2602 releases including:

  • Collaborative Draft
  • Draft Scope
  • Recommendations
  • Editable Treeview
  • Analytical Table (Read-Only)

The features will be presented upfront so that the participants can decide which feature(s) they want to implement by just using the Develop Applications section of our SAP Online Help.

As said this event is NOT suited for absolute beginners since we expect that the participants have a solid knowledge of ABAP Cloud and the development of RAP business objects.   Please do not register if you do not fit within this profile. 

This is an in-person event only (not virtual) and is planned for Friday 20th February 2026 in Walldorf from 10:00 - 16:00 CET.   The language and content of the event will be in English.

 

Location:  SAP SE,   Building WDF21,   Hasso-Plattner-Ring 7 ,  69190 Walldorf,  Germany

For more information about how to get to the event, please check...  how-to-find-wdf-18-21.pdf  

Please note that spaces are limited - we can only accommodate 35 attendees.

 If you wish to attend, register by clicking the Yes button in the Will you be attending? section above to the right. Two weeks before the event, we will ask you to confirm your attendance.

 

The instructors are Andre Fischer and several colleagues from the ABAP Platform Development Unit. We will provide an SAP BTP ABAP Environment system with the latest 2602 release.  Please be sure to have the LATEST ADT installed  https://developers.sap.com/tutorials/abap-install-adt..html

 

We plan to collect feedback for the documentation and materials being used in the hands-on using issues in  Github.com, so please create a Github.com account in order to leverage that important feedback channel during the workshop.

 For more information about how to get to the event, please check

  • How-to-find-WDF.cdr
  • https://goo.gl/maps/8ZLSUio4fQD9VUF39

Please note that spaces are limited - we can only accommodate 35 attendees.

  • VSCode: ABAP Development Tools for Visual Studio Code | SAP Tutorials
